title: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M gfx1151: the packed workspace lease follows the serving capacity
claim: The eager packed-execution KV workspace lease takes one slot per serving capacity instead of the fixed eight-slot fallback, cutting pinned workspace pages 8x at C1 and 2x at C4 on an 8192-token session, with every measured request still completing at both capacities.
purpose: Task #7: the lease slot term read `max_batch_size` from the resident model runner, an attribute that runner never has, so `packed_verify_lease_slot_ceiling` always fell back to _PACKED_VERIFY_DEFAULT_SLOT_CAPACITY = 8. Repair the term from the serving capacity and re-measure pinned/current pages at C1 and C4.
hardware: zbook, Ryzen AI MAX+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S (gfx1151)

change.why_the_old_term_was_dead: `_resident_model_runner` is set on the generator (hipengine/generation/qwen35_gguf.py:1722), not on the resident model runner that calls configure_engine_loop, so the lookup was always None. Every resident session is built with the runner's capacity as its packed width (`_acquire_shared_session(..., max_batch_size=self.capacity)`), and slot views carry a width of one, which is why the term cannot come from an arbitrary resident session.
change.why_capacity_is_the_exact_bound: One MTP verify job is one request row: hipengine/generation/qwen35_gguf_mtp2.py builds one job per request_id with input_token_ids = (root, *candidates) and calls verify_target_blocks_batch under target_verifier_active_slots_session(len(jobs)); that method creates one _GGUFPackedVerifySlotBlock per job, so layout.slot_count is the number of speculative rows, at most the serving capacity. A K=3 verify group is therefore 4 rows in 1 slot, not 4 slots. Packed AR decode passes slot_count=rows for a group the loop caps at the capacity, and step_hidden_batch_native refuses rows <= 1, so its slot_count=rows is bounded by the capacity as well. Measured: the largest slot count any layout requested was 1 at C1 and the largest union was 4 at C4, matching the capacity in both cases.

protocol.driver_description: Installs in-process probes on Qwen35GGUFResidentSession._packed_verify_union_geometry, _ensure_packed_verify_workspace, and _GGUFPackedTargetState.allocate; builds LLM + create_app and drives the real in-process server through fastapi.testclient.TestClient; records kv_pool_memory_snapshot(), the pool stats, the resolved context, every geometry/workspace request, the source digest, and the MTP route reported by each response.
requests_per_run: a long prompt targeting ~3530 tokens (measured 5469 prompt tokens) with `speculative_mtp: true`, 8 output tokens
protocol.env: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151, HIPENGINE_GGUF_AUTO_CONTEXT as noted, bf16 KV, production execution profile, prefix_cache off
protocol.auto_config: default auto context resolution, --max-sequence-length 8192 as the request ceiling
protocol.note: MTP did not engage in any run (route null, no speculative_mtp payload): the production serving plan does not admit MTP on this box's gfx1151 cells. The verify geometry is therefore pinned by the layout contract test rather than a live verify group.
protocol.driver_note: The probe is committed so the measurement is reproducible from the repository; it installs in-process probes on the union geometry, the workspace allocation, and the packed target state, drives the real in-process server through fastapi.testclient.TestClient, and records kv_pool_memory_snapshot(), the pool stats, the resolved context, every geometry/workspace request, the source digest, and the route each response reports.

commands.before_arm: git stash push -- hipengine/generation/qwen35_gguf.py, then the same probe command; the before rows ran the /tmp/lease-probe-mtp.py build of this probe, which records the same fields

after.note: Reproduced with the committed probe: 32 pages, pinned 32, current 160, HIP used 30.24 GiB, 0 workspace failures.
Reproduced with the committed probe: 128 pages, pinned 128, current 256, HIP used 32.55 GiB, 0 workspace failures.

C1.note: Pages fall 4x while the resolved context doubles: the auto-context resolver spends the freed 48 GiB on context (8 slots x 512 pages at 131072 becomes 1 slot x 1024 pages at 262144).

C4.note: Flat on pages by construction: 8 slots x 512 pages at 131072 equals 4 slots x 1024 pages at 262144. The slot term halved; the resolved context doubled.

geometry_evidence.conclusion: No layout in either run requested more slots than the serving capacity, and at C1 no layout requested more than one, so the eight-slot floor was pure over-reservation.

serving_outcome.http_200: 3 of 3 requests per run at both capacities
serving_outcome.long_prompt: 5469 prompt tokens, 8 output tokens, prefilled and generated at both capacities
serving_outcome.mtp_note: The production plan does not admit MTP on this box's gfx1151 cells, so no verify group ran live; the K=3 verify geometry (4 rows in 1 slot) is pinned by test_mtp_verify_width_packs_rows_inside_one_slot.

unit_gate.green_after: 52 tests pass across the five named files

followups: The per-slot term is now the dominant reservation: ceil(session max context / 256) pages per slot, i.e. 1024 pages (16 GiB) per slot at a 262144-token auto context while the realized union stayed at 5469 tokens. Recorded in docs/REFACTOR.md.

estimate_qwen35_gguf_kv_capacity prices the lease with max_batch_size=1 while the pool leases one slot per capacity, under-reporting 48 GiB at C4 on a 262144-token session. Recorded in docs/REFACTOR.md.
